slides.say: You already have an Effect that depends on room id. It is tempting to drop your analytics call in there too.
Later you add a dependency that must reconnect. Now every reconnect also logs another visit for the same room. Not what you meant.
Split them into two Effects. Logging a visit and connecting are separate processes.

slides.text: Test: delete one Effect. Does the other still work? Then they’re separate.
slides.say: A good test: if deleting one Effect does not break the other, they sync different things. Decide by process, not by what looks cleaner.
